description.text: In order to attract more high-quality overseas talents, Hunan University optimizes resources and expands the diversification of programs. The university takes innovations to integrate the teaching staff and materials of College of Economics and Trade, College of Accounting and College of Finance and Statistics into a good cycling of teaching resources so as to apply for an program of economics to the Ministry of Education China and China Scholarship Council and received approval in March of 2009. Thecourse could be taught in English if there are 15 or more international students.

duration.text: The Financial Management at Hunan University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2361 USD/per year ￥ 17000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school

requirements.text: Course Qualifications Deadline Undergraduate Graduate of senior high school or equivalent July 1 Non-Chinese citizen holding a valid foreign passport may apply directly to the Overseas Students' Office of the College of International Studies, Hunan University.
